Planning Document: Marrickville DCP 2011 - 9 0 Introduction

Clause Part 9 - zoning (land_use_zoning): Part 9 of this DCP divides the land where this DCP applies into 47 planning precincts.

Clause Part 9 - other (development_control): Each planning precinct has its own distinct character and provides an important contextual basis for establishing appropriate types of development in association with other controls within the DCP.

Clause Part 9 - other (development_control): Each precinct has an existing and desired future character to guide development within the area.

Clause Part 9 - other (development_control): Planning controls and objectives have been applied to precinct-specific areas and site-specific areas (through masterplans) to assist in achieving the desired future character.

Clause Part 9 - heritage (development_control): Heritage conservation areas if located within a precinct are referenced.
